==15%==
In a road with exactly 26 houses, if Em lives at number 13 and Bea lives at number 2, logically what number house does Elle live at?

The 26 houses represent the 26 letters in the alphabet. Bea is B and therefore lives at number 2. Em is M and therefore lives at number 13. That means that Elle who is L lives at number '''12'''.

Repeatedly strike the area not on top of but on every side of the shrub.

Repeatedly strike = '''beat'''.<br>The area not on top of but on every side of = '''around'''.<br>The shrub = '''the bush'''.
